title: Blueberry Iced Tea
excerpt: Refresh your afternoons with an exquisite homemade iced tea infused with the natural sweetness of Fresh Pick blueberries and an irresistible citrus touch.
imageAlt: Tall glass of blueberry iced tea, ice cubes, whole blueberries floating and a sprig of fresh mint.

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 tablespoons bee honey or grated panela

steps: Heat 2 cups of water until it comes to a boil. Remove from the heat, add the tea bags and steep for 5 minutes. Remove the tea bags without squeezing them.

In a small pot, combine the Fresh Pick blueberries with 1/2 cup of water and the honey. Cook over medium heat for 7 minutes, gently mashing the fruit with a fork to release all its juice. We use half the usual sweetener because Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar.
Pour the blueberry concentrate over the tea infusion, passing the mixture through a strainer for a crystal-clear drink, or add it straight in if you prefer to feel the natural pulp.
Add the lemon juice and the remaining 1 1/2 cups of cold water. Mix well.
Let it cool to room temperature and then refrigerate for at least 1 hour to intensify the flavors.
Serve in tall glasses full of ice, garnished with whole blueberries and mint leaves to taste.
tips: Take advantage of the natural sweetness of 13° to 15° Brix of our high-mountain Fresh Pick blueberries grown in Guasca; you will see they need very little extra honey to get the perfect balance.
To keep the bloom intact and the maximum freshness of your blueberries at home, store them in the fridge unwashed and rinse them only right before making your recipe.
This recipe uses half the usual sweetener: Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar, so we cut it back. Taste it and, if you prefer it sweeter, add a little more.
